website.promotion: Exact accepted draft restored to production without rebuilding

backend.scope: Only these eleven account-access callables were deployed; no gateway or rules release.

behavior.poseTekIssuer: /admin/access (Account access in the administrator account menu)
behavior.delivery: Manual sharing of a private activation or recovery link; no email delivery in the managed flow
behavior.staffActivation: Canonical organization membership and assigned teams; does not verify email
behavior.internalAdministratorActivation: Existing administrator, recent sign-in and explicit identity/address confirmation; bound exact @posetek.net identity receives the existing verified-domain authority
behavior.recovery: Existing enabled UID only; changes password and revokes refresh sessions, preserving email verification, memberships and authority
behavior.interruptedWrites: Durable stages, exact-UID acknowledgement and fail-closed ambiguous Auth outcomes; no password or enable replay
behavior.legacy: Existing CLUB invitations retain their verification contract; explicit replacement creates an email-free link

cleanup.scope: Synthetic Auth identities, organization and nested membership/profile documents, teams, invitations, access grants/targets/audit, coaches/admins profiles and asynchronous social deletion tombstones. No fixture players or storage objects were created.
cleanup.excluded: Operational rate-limit counters and normal service/analytics logs are retained; shared IP limits are not removed or bypassed.

excludedCollections.accountAccessRateLimits: Operational hashed IP/UID rate counters are intentionally retained; no counters were read or changed.

limits: Browser acceptance used desktop Edge at mobile viewport sizes; no new native build or physical-device acceptance is claimed.
Previously issued ID tokens may remain valid until expiry; recovery does not claim instant revocation of every active token.
Uncertain account-enabling outcomes remain held for operator review.

nativeContract.scope: Documentation only; no native code, rules, build or deployment changed.
